initial_requirements: Researchers need a standalone application for playing and extending combinatorial games based on triangulations. Players with varying technical experience should be able to choose among several game types and play alone, against computer-controlled opponents, or with another person through an accessible graphical interface. Game developers should also be able to define new games and make them available without modifying the original application.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What specific actions and capabilities should the application provide for players and game developers—for example, game selection, solo play, computer opponents, two-player play, and creating or adding new games without changing the core application?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
Players should be able to open the app, browse the available triangulation-based games, and pick one to play without needing technical setup. From there, they should have options to play alone, play against a computer opponent, or play head-to-head with another person on the same accessible interface.
For game developers, the application should let them define a new game as a separate add-on or module and then make it appear in the list of available games. Ideally they should not need to modify or recompile the core application just to add new games, but I’d want to confirm the exact plugin or extension mechanism with the team.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Provide a standalone, accessible application for playing and extending triangulation-based combinatorial games, supporting multiple play modes and easy addition of new games without modifying the core app.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Players with varying technical experience; game developers who create and add new games; researchers as the primary consumers of the application.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Users should be able to browse and select available triangulation-based games, play solo, play against a computer opponent, or play head-to-head with another person through the same accessible graphical interface. Developers should be able to define new games as add-ons/modules and have them appear in the available games list.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: New games should be added as separate modules/add-ons and become available in the app without modifying or recompiling the core application, subject to the eventual plugin/extension mechanism.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Triangulation-based games and the list/catalog of available games, including newly added add-on or module-based games.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: The application should be standalone, accessible, and should ideally allow new games to be added without changing or recompiling the core application; the exact plugin/extension mechanism is not yet confirmed.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Accessibility, ease of use for non-technical players, and extensibility for developers.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
slots.value: No specific edge cases provided yet; only the intended support for adding games without core application changes and confirmation needed on the extension mechanism.
